_comment: The ratchet baseline for verify_rules.py on THIS repo's own corpus (enforcement/README.md, decision 2). The count may only fall; the verifier fails the commit when it rises, and fails when it falls until this number is lowered in the same commit. Past the deadline any gap fails. Only a person moves the deadline, and the move is recorded under 'moves' with who and why.
